messages:
maria_reed: Hey team — Safekeep wants to go live with the POC next week but legal flagged the KMS section in the security questionnaire. They also say their HSM vendor requires an allowlist. Can we confirm what we need from them to avoid delays?

alex_kim: I can take the lead. Quick checklist: 1) network allowlist + IPs, 2) attestation cert (PKCS#7 or x509), 3) key wrapping algorithm (RSA-OAEP/RSASSA?), 4) rotation window expectations.

maria_reed: Perfect. They asked if we support customer-owned HSMs with offline key ceremony and whether we bill for the handshake. Any short answer for procurement?

olivia_murphy: Short: yes, we support BYO-HSM in Private/Dedicated. Billing: there's an onboarding/ops fee (one-time) + a small monthly connector charge for HSM proxying. I can post the quote line item.

julian_ng: Security note: customer must provide FIPS-validated attestation or equivalent. We require the attestation artifact for the initial onboarding. Also ask them to complete section K (Key Custody) in the questionnaire — paste request block below.

julian_ng: ```Please attach: (a) HSM attestation certificate; (b) key-wrapping algorithm and key lifecycle diagram; (c) proof of KMS rotation policy (min interval, max age).```

alex_kim: For the allowlist, use these egress IPs and ports (sample):

alex_kim: ```
- 34.201.12.45/32: 443 TLS to proxy
- 34.201.12.46/32: 443 TLS fallback
- Ports: outbound 443 TCP, 5000-5010 for ephemeral health checks (optional)
```

maria_reed: Can we offer a fallback so they can start the POC without doing the ceremony first? They want to run smoke tests this week.

olivia_murphy: Yep — offer a staged plan: Phase 1: use Redwood-managed keys (fast: <48h). Phase 2: schedule BYO-HSM ceremony (2-3 business days ops + coordinator). We'll flag Prod cutover only after attestation and rotation policy verified.

alex_kim: Also call out the small perf delta for proxied HSM ops — roughly 6-12ms per signing op depending on region. If they need sub-10ms tail latency we can propose local dedicated pool in same AZ.

maria_reed: Good to know — procurement asked if the attestation process will impact go-live date. Can we commit to timeline if they hand over artifacts by EOD Tuesday?

olivia_murphy: If artifacts in by EOD Tue: onboarding runbook + firewall test on Wed, dry-run ceremony Thu, sign-off Fri. Ops fee invoice Tue. I'll block time with infra.

julian_ng: I'll review the attestation doc once they upload — ping me in thread.

maria_reed: I'll send them the questionnaire excerpt + allowlist snippet and offer the staged plan. Thanks all. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Safekeep POC cutover readiness" on 2026-04-22 15:00 UTC. Invite sent to maria_reed, alex_kim, olivia_murphy, julian_ng.
